name: run_python
description: Run Python code in the sandbox; returns stdout, stderr, exit_code, results.

name: run_command
description: Run one shell command in the sandbox; same shape as run_python.

name: read_file
description: Read a file from the sandbox filesystem as text.

name: write_file
description: Write text to a file in the sandbox filesystem.

name: list_files
description: List a directory in the sandbox filesystem.

name: sandbox_info
description: Backend, isolation tier, capabilities and the policy in effect.
